entry.name: biquad~
entry.description: biquad~ implements a two-pole, two-zero filter using the following equation: y[n] = a0 * x[n] + a1 * x[n-1] + a2 * x[n-2] - b1 * y[n-1] - b2 * y[n-2] You can specify the coefficients a0, a1, a2, b1, and b2 as signals or floats (if you make the filter explode by making the b coefficients too high, you can recover (after lowering them) with the clear message, or by turning the audio on and off).

arguments.name: a0
arguments.description: Set the initial value for the a0 filter coefficient. If a signal is connected to the second inlet, the coefficient supplied as an argument is ignored.

arguments.name: a1
arguments.description: Set the initial value for the a1 filter coefficient. If a signal is connected to the third inlet, the coefficient supplied as an argument is ignored.

arguments.name: a2
arguments.description: Set the initial value for the a2 filter coefficient. If a signal is connected to the fourth inlet, the coefficient supplied as an argument is ignored.

arguments.name: b1
arguments.description: Set the initial value for the b1 filter coefficient. If a signal is connected to the fifth inlet, the coefficient supplied as an argument is ignored.

arguments.name: b2
arguments.description: Set the initial value for the b2 filter coefficient. If a signal is connected to the sixth inlet, the coefficient supplied as an argument is ignored.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Clears theobject's memory of previous inputs and outputs, resetting xn-1, xn-2, yn-1, and yn-2 to 0.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol that references a namedobject dictionary (set via theattribute), will cause theobject to use the dictionary values for filter coefficients.

messages.name: float
messages.description: The coefficients in inlets 2 to 6 may be specified by ainstead of a signal. If a signal is also connected to the inlet, theis ignored.

messages.name: int
messages.description: Converted to.The coefficients in inlets 2 to 6 may be specified by a number instead of a signal. If a signal is also connected to the inlet, the number value is ignored.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set the filter using a list of five filter coefficients
messages.description: The five filter coefficients can be provided as ain the left inlet. The first number in theis coefficient a0, the next is a1, and so on. If a signal is connected to a given inlet, the coefficient supplied in thefor that inlet is ignored.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: Signal to be filtered. The filter mixes the current input sample with the two previous input samples and the two previous output samples according to the formula:yn = a0xn + a1xn-1 + a2xn-2 - b1yn-1 - b2yn-2.In 2nd inlet: Amplitude coefficient a0, for scaling the amount of the current input to be passed directly to the output.In 3rd inlet: Amplitude coefficient a1, for scaling the amount of the previous input sample to be added to the output.In 4th inlet: Amplitude coefficient a2, for scaling the amount of input sample n-2 to be added to the output.In 5th inlet: Amplitude coefficient b1, for scaling the amount of the previous output sample to be added to the current output.In right inlet: Amplitude coefficient b2, for scaling the amount of output sample n-2 to be added to the current output. .

messages.name: stoke
messages.description: The word, followed by a list that specifies a set of filter coefficient values, will preload the filter so that it starts in a given initial state, allowing the filter to be used for purposes such as a ringing oscillator.
